b.answer:
Worked example: a learner's Harvest Lane capstone in test mode with test data, self-scored. Built: HL·00–HL·06 (n8n), HL·07 books sync (Make) and HL·09 social inbox.

Rubric areaEvidence submittedScore
Works end to end12 of 12 applicable tests pass (9, 14–16 not built); HL-0412 traced in 9 events rows; one Instagram lead traced to first order HL-041920 / 20
DesignOne-page map; contract for customers, orders, stock, events, settings; one owner per table; a one-sentence reason for each platform15 / 15
SafetySignature + verify + amount + unique paystack_ref; refunds and orders over ₦100,000 wait for Tolu; Paystack secret in one place; kill switch passes test 1215 / 15
Monitoringn8n and Make errors reach one Telegram channel; 30-minute watchdog; outcome checks for rejected signatures, 0-order reports, paid orders not dispatched, stock below zero, template quality; Glitch's three faults replayed and all three alerted20 / 20
Handover packA classmate fixed the renamed-column fault from section 4 alone in 11 minutes15 / 15
Results and presentationBoard below; method stated; six parts, but ran 4:4013 / 15

Results board: 87 h saved a month (₦130,000) · 52 orders won back (₦123,500 profit at 25%) · net ₦215,500 a month after ₦38,000 running costs. Method: "before" from one week of timing Tolu (12 minutes an order) and counting unanswered chats (15); "after" timed on test runs; 3 lost orders after is an estimate, labelled. Total: 98 / 100, all four must-haves ticked.
mistakes: Watching only for errors, so the renamed column and the old Paystack secret run green and nobody is told.
Two workflows writing the same table (for example the Make sync updating order status), breaking one owner per table.
Letting the AI add up the weekly report totals from raw rows instead of SQL or code.
Results counted as full order value instead of profit, or estimates not labelled, with no method stated.
b.pass: Evidence for all six rubric areas totalling 80 or more, and all four must-haves proven: a log of every applicable test passing, verified payments with refunds waiting for Tolu, errors from every platform in the build reaching one channel, and a named person who fixed a test fault from section 4 alone; plus a 4-minute recording in six parts.
b.redo: Send it back if any must-have fails, the score is under 80, the cross-platform edge or growth workflow is missing, the demo shows live keys or real customer data, or the results have no stated method.

s.answer:
Worked example: Okonkwo Pharmacy, Bodija (the fictional pharmacy from 6.1), adapted from the Harvest Lane shape.

PH·01 Intake (n8n, WhatsApp) → refill request, or question
PH·02 Refill agent: AI reads the request; the pharmacist approves every item
PH·03 Payment on collection or delivery (any Paystack link verified as HL·03)
PH·04 Pickup-ready message: approved template, no medicine names
PH·05 Questions: hours, location, delivery areas; anything about medicines
      → pharmacist
PH·06 Daily refill check (6.1) · PH·07 Low-stock alert · PH·00 Errors +
      watchdog · every row in events carries request_id, e.g. RX-0215
TableKey columnsOwner (writes)Readers
customerscustomer_id, name, phone, consent (yes/no, date), refill_duePH·01; consent changed only by PH·01 on STOPPH·02, PH·06
requestsrequest_id, customer_id, items (internal), status: requested · approved · ready · collected · declined, approved_byPH·02 (create, approve) and PH·04 (ready)PH·05, reports
stockitem, qty, reorder_levelStaff, by handPH·07
eventsat, workflow, request_id, event, detail (never medicine names)Every workflow appendsWatchdog, reports

Outcome checks:

  1. Refills due in 3 days with consent = yes but no reminder_sent event by 10:00 → alert.
  2. Approved requests not marked ready within 4 hours → alert the pharmacist.
  3. Any outgoing message containing a word from the medicines list → blocked and alerted.

Industry review (a community pharmacist): she flagged that (1) drug names were in events.detail, so they were removed; (2) prescription-only items need the prescription seen in person, so a "prescription seen" tick was added before approval; (3) a STOP must end reminders the same day, so it was added to PH·01 and tested.
mistakes: Swapping the nouns but letting the agent approve items; the pharmacist (or bursar, or owner) must approve.
Medicine names, children's details or other sensitive data in messages, logs or events.
"Outcome checks" that are really error alerts ("node failed") instead of business rules.
Getting the review from a friend outside the industry, or not recording what was fixed.
s.pass: A redrawn map, a data contract with one owner per table, three business outcome checks, and a note naming the industry reviewer, what they flagged and how each point was fixed.
s.redo: Send it back if the map is Harvest Lane with renamed boxes, any table has several writers, sensitive data travels in messages or logs, or there's no evidence of an industry review.

Build and handoverReminders, replies, freed-slot alerts, Monday summary; error workflow, watchdog and outcome check; handover pack signed by Adaeze

MeasureBefore (1 week, timed)After (4 weeks, events table)
Minutes per booking72
Bookings a week6060
No-shows a week31

Results (staff ₦1,200/h, ₦8,000 a slot, 60% margin, ₦15,000 running): 22 h saved a month (₦26,000) + 9 slots kept (₦41,600 profit) = ₦52,600 net a month; payback about 4.8 months. Lower than the scope's estimate because it counts profit, not revenue, and uses measured figures.

CASE STUDY · Saturday no-shows down from 3 a week to 1
Client: Adaeze's Salon, Enugu (named with written permission)
Problem, results, how it's safe, client quote, stack, demo link

Submit: the signed scope, payment receipts, the handover sign-off, four weeks of monitoring log, the before-and-after sheet with your method, and the case study with the owner's written approval to publish.
mistakes: Skipping the signed scope or payment, so the job is a favour and "done" is never defined.
Reporting results after one week, or with no measured "before".
Publishing the case study or the owner's name without written permission.
Switching monitoring off after go-live, so the four weeks have no log.
g.pass: A signed scope, proof of payment, a handover sign-off, four weeks of monitoring log, a before-and-after table with a stated method, and a case study the owner approved in writing.
g.redo: Send it back if any of payment, sign-off or written permission is missing, the run is under four weeks, or the numbers are estimates presented as measurements.
